the exchange holds still, door open; the line between laptop and door brightens as the one thing in question, everything else dims
a magnifier on the password token as it sits on the line: only a row of characters, nothing tying it to this laptop; a second, distant laptop fades in at the frame edge on 'any device'
a copy of the password token peels off and travels from the distant laptop along a second line to the same door; the door opens for the copy exactly as it did for you
back to the single exchange; three slots stand beside the door and fill on their words, the password token, the phone, a fingerprint; the know and have slots become two locks on the door
the copy travels the second line again and opens the first lock; the second lock waits; the code lights up on your phone beside your laptop, far from the copy; the copy bounces off the door
a meter mounted on the door fills to just over 99 on the spoken number, the study's owner labelled under it in small type; on 'not a guarantee' a thin unfilled sliver at the top stays visible
a second box slides into the line between laptop and door, splicing it in two; it wears the door's face exactly; your password and code tokens leave the laptop and travel toward it
everything freezes with both tokens poised at the edge of the look-alike box; the frame rests in silence

the magnifier moves onto the code token: plain characters, the same copyable look the password had in run one, the two set side by side
a cutaway of the phone: inside, a sealed key sits in its own compartment; a fingerprint touches the glass and the compartment lights, the key does not move

the exchange returns with the cutaway phone in place of the code: a challenge token travels from the door to the phone, the sealed key stamps it, the signed answer travels back; the key itself never leaves its compartment
the magnifier settles on the signed answer; an address stamp presses onto it on 'address' and stays, the one saturated thing in frame

the stacked prompts resolve into one refusal; behind the phone the look-alike box from run three fades in briefly at the end of the line and the door stays shut

three short lines set one by one on their words beside the held exchange; each line lands on the token it changes
